# Fish-Oid

> Free AI-powered identification tool for fishing, hunting, and marine life. Wrapped inside The Harbour Village — a learning hub plus a community layer.

## Pages

- [The Harbour Village](https://fish-oid.co.uk/): identify/roast a catch, gear, or game; Learn (tides, fish ID tips, conservation); Q&A; Ask Captain Barnacle; Gear; Village (kudos, leaderboard, activity feed)

## What it does

- **Identify / Roast** (`analyze-image.js`, free, no sign-in): upload a photo — Fish-Oid (character voice: Dave the Rave) identifies your catch, gear, or game, or roasts it.
- **Ask Captain Barnacle** (`chat-barnacle.js`, free, no sign-in): a retired North Sea trawlerman turned marine biologist answers questions about fish ID, tackle, or the sea.
- **The Village**: a Supabase-backed community layer (kudos, leaderboard, activity feed). Signing in is Supabase email/password, not Patreon, and unlocks kudos/tracking/village features — never the identify, roast, or chat tools, which work and show a result before any sign-in prompt.

## Who it's for

Anglers, hunters, and anyone curious about marine life who wants a fast identification or a chat with someone who knows the sea.

## Tech

Gemini 2.0 Flash (identify/roast) and Gemini 2.5 Flash (Ask Captain Barnacle) · Supabase · Netlify Functions

## Membership (informational only — no feature on this site is gated behind it)

Villager £4.95/month · Elder earned, not bought · Founder £14.95/month — patreon.com/chrisptee
